rule.title: Unlawful Use or Distribution of Common Pricing Algorithm in Restraint of Trade
rule.requirement: A person is prohibited from using or distributing a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce.
rule.exemptions: The term person does not include the end consumer of a product or service. [Business and Professions Code § 16729(d)(5)]
rule.interaction: Nothing in Section 16729 impairs or limits the applicability of antitrust laws.

rule.title: Coercion to Adopt Recommended Price or Term via Common Pricing Algorithm
rule.requirement: A person is prohibited from using or distributing a common pricing algorithm if they coerce another person to set or adopt a price or commercial term recommended by the algorithm for the same or similar products or services within the state.
rule.exemptions: The term person does not include the end consumer of a product or service. [Business and Professions Code § 16729(d)(5)]
rule.interaction: Nothing in Section 16729 impairs or limits the applicability of antitrust laws.
